case.summary: This case was triggered when the bank's real-time model scored transaction 3514030 for $77.07 in billing region 444.0 at 0.61. Graph evidence showed that the transaction model scored the event at a very low 0.005. Furthermore, the account has a history of 10 prior card-present purchases in the same billing region with no prior fraud cases, and the amount is typical for the card. The cardholder successfully confirmed they made the purchase. The verdict is legitimate, and the final actions are ALLOW_TRANSACTION and CLOSE_NO_FRAUD.
